title: Two duplicated sites are folded into one shared helper
why: ADVERSARIAL, and the mirror of the copy case. DocView.WireA and DocView.WireB were duplicates; revision B deletes both and records them as merged into DocView.Wire, which still carries the defect. The trap is that N:1 looks exactly like 1:1 plus a fix: a mapper that continues one predecessor and calls the other `ended` reports a repair that never happened, and the removed_symbols record would even seem to back it up. Both predecessors are equally supported, so the honest answer is one merged edge naming both.

expect.note: occ-b1 takes a freshly minted id recording BOTH parent LINEAGES - each seeded as a root first, since neither predecessor is linked yet. Inheriting occ-a1's would elect it and orphan occ-a2 without ever saying so.

forbid: continued from occ-a1 with occ-a2 ended
continued from occ-a2 with occ-a1 ended
either predecessor reported as ended on the strength of removed_symbols - the site moved into the merge target, and merged_symbols says where
a merge recorded with fewer parent lineages than predecessors
an occurrence id in parent_lineage instead of the lineage it belongs to
